title: research: exclude P112 profile 2^2,6^5,7^3 by A3 binary closure
body:
## Summary

Exclude the actual P112 TWOSIDE `(6,4)` profile `2^2,6^5,7^3` over every characteristic-zero field. The new A3 lemma retains one binary six-flat and resolves the equality case using the original endpoint ranks.

```text
2^2,6^5,7^3
  delete three pieces: retain three code dimensions
  six-flat plus four common coordinates: support demand >= 80
  equality: each endpoint is confined to sixteen live labels
  four endpoints: support <= 64, a contradiction
```

Only `research/p112-a3-six-flat/` is added. It contains the written proof, original-caller label bridge, exact source pins, two separate finite implementations, complete equality evidence and reproduction instructions.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 for TWOSIDE, Nick Petalas/PR3211 for deletion and normalization, PR3217 for the support-only versus binary-rank distinction, and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. The separately claimed nine-piece `2,6^5,7^3` case has a different support budget and is credited as concurrent work. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19002468).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the arbitrary-support relaxation gives `76 <= 80`; even the six-flat bound reaches only equality `80 = 80`.
  **After:** both complete enumerations identify sixty equality pairs. All 240 mandatory singleton sets have size sixteen, rank six and live closure sixteen, ruling out the original endpoint supports.
- Both methods check all 788,035 binary six-spaces and 2,025 frames. The primary uses annihilator kernels; the separate implementation reconstructs roots/labels and uses affine five-flats. Complete maximizing sets and equality witnesses agree.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and fifteen optimized behavioral groups pass. Ruff checks and compilation pass. All three mathematical commands also pass under optimized Python 3.13 from the exact committed, read-only, Git-free export. All fifteen publication files match committed bytes.

```sh
RUN="$HOME/.cache/integer-mult-bounds-runs/p112-a3-six-flat-replay"
mkdir -p "$RUN/tmp"
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a3-six-flat
```

`CHECKS.json` records sources, environments, internal reviews and the complete-pagination overlap snapshot. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and original TWOSIDE reduction remain explicit dependencies. This is one author-checked profile exclusion; full C5, the decoder floor, suppliers and kappa remain open or unchanged. Hosted CI and independent human/formal review are separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

An isolated research package; selected records, shared code and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
